result.reason: The redline appropriately narrows TrueLink’s rights in Credit Data and confirms Client ownership of Customer Data. However, stating that Client “retains” ownership of Support Services work product does not effect a present assignment of deliverables created by TrueLink. It also omits the required treatment of TrueLink’s pre-existing or embedded IP, including a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence, and does not address joint ownership. Nor does it fully implement the fallback licence structure. The added de-identified service-improvement right and broader references to Client Content and Client IP go beyond what was necessary to revise this Credit Data licence. Drafting is generally clear but incomplete as an ownership clause.
